name: chemdraw-mcp
description: Molecule names or SMILES to publication-style 2D structures, reaction schemes, mechanisms, TLC plates, titration curves and lab maths - rendered offline with RDKit.
long_description: Describe a molecule, a reaction or a lab result in plain words and get the figure: print-ready PNG/SVG plus an interactive preview in the chat. 20 tools for pharmacy and chemistry students. The bundle is a launcher: on first start it fetches the chemdraw-mcp package from PyPI via uv (installed if missing) and caches it; afterwards rendering runs entirely on your machine. Not affiliated with Revvity/ChemDraw.
